map_selection: one complete requested map and actual effective ancestors
parent_policy: ParentMapID when nonnegative; otherwise CosmeticParentMapID; no secondary branch union
id_policy: same serial allocator and original relative order inside selected closure; no full-world assigned-ID equality
navigation: none or Map(requested) to enable navigation for the complete selected map-and-ancestors domain; each member emits only its own candidate tiles; requires mmaps and LiquidType; explicit inline offmesh header including empty
offmesh_map_scope: requested map only; ancestors receive no custom records; valid records for an own-empty requested map may remain unused

verification.navigation_global_domain: exact union of selected-domain members with own MAPS or own payload .vmtile candidates; zero for a wholly empty domain

resource_accounting: Compact domain plus selected direct numeric navigation-row capacities are checked against 64 KiB and reduce existing navigation discovery/pipeline budgets. Domain alone reduces terrain, disk combined, VMO/package budgets. Full source decoder/graph and compact facts overlap during preparation. Five verifier vectors have a separate 24 KiB logical allowance. These are not exact RSS or all CPU-work guarantees.

navigation_output_policy.source_rows: complete direct numeric projection for selected domain from the same authenticated Map bytes, preserving original relative order and both parent fields
navigation_output_policy.discovery: Package::open_rows with Options::default over the closed projection; nav::Selection::All
navigation_output_policy.candidate_union: own MAPS files and own VMap payload .vmtile files; parent-only .vmtileidx is excluded
navigation_output_policy.ancestor_outputs: required navigation dependencies are emitted for ancestor members with own candidates
navigation_output_policy.own_empty_map: no global or tile output; do not copy inherited candidate tiles to the child
navigation_output_policy.wholly_empty_domain: valid complete selected domain may produce zero navigation files
navigation_output_policy.native_semantics: same original discoverTiles/buildMap own-candidate policy and ultimate-root parameter inventory; not full native route or runtime acceptance
